project_title: Multi-Sensor Flood Mapping in the Timure/Rasuwa Gorge
fusion_sources: Sentinel-2 optical change features (AUG27 minus AUG24)
features: Six Sentinel-2 band differences (B02, B03, B04, B08, B11, B12) plus the MNDWI difference between AUG27 and AUG24.
validation: RepeatedStratifiedKFold with 2 folds and 10 repeats (20 splits), random_state=42. Values are means and population standard deviations across splits. No spatial grouping or independent external holdout was used.
key_conclusion: The MLP had the highest reported mean accuracy and weighted F1 in this run. The observed accuracy range between models (0.0595) is smaller than the largest reported split-level standard deviation (0.0664); this is a descriptive comparison, not a statistical significance test. Results are exploratory given 45 samples and the absence of spatially independent validation.
limitations: The evaluated seven features are Sentinel-2 optical change features; these metrics do not evaluate Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 feature fusion.
Repeated stratified random splits do not account for spatial dependence or establish independent external performance.
Only 45 labeled samples (30 background and 15 flood) were used.
No trained model artifact or flood-classification raster is included in this results export.
source: Reported output from the supplied model comparison run. Served statically; the API does not retrain models on startup.
